component: Sent-file and folder copy completion guard

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: OnCreateFinished now routes failed status to OnCopyCompleted before reading the destination key or marking a sent-file message read. Success requires a non-null header before those actions, and move deletion remains later. The real file/folder callback lambdas discard the inner return, so this local failure fix must not be broadened into a guarantee that every unexpected header or MarkRead error reaches copy-service completion. No message creation, failure injection, queue or move operation was run.
title: A failed Exchange message creation completes before the optional header is used
